喚.meaning: Grandad opens a birthday present. Out springs a <part>jack-in-the-box</part> with a huge painted <part>mouth</part>, so suddenly that his glasses fly across the room. He leaps onto the sofa and lets out the loudest <kanji>yell</kanji> the street has ever heard.
喚.on: To say sorry, the toy holds out a pink <sound>car</sound>nation in its spring.
喚.kun: '<sound>Wah</sound>!' he howls again, and hides behind a <sound>me</sound>lon in the fruit bowl.

摂.meaning: An old sailor can't go to sea any more. He drops a toy <part>anchor</part> in his bath, holds a radio to his <part>ear</part> for his grandson's reports from the frozen north and sucks chips of <part>ice</part> to feel the cold. He's on every voyage, but his adventures are all <kanji>vicarious</kanji>.
摂.on: His red <sound>set</sound>ter lies by the tub and shivers along with him.
摂.kun: He hangs the radio on a little <sound>to</sound>tem pole beside the tub to take in every word.

搭.meaning: A traveller's <part>picnic basket</part> is so heavy that she hooks it to the ship's <part>anchor</part> chain and lets the winch haul it up, with her clinging to the handle. The gulls cheer as she swings over the rail. It's the strangest way anyone has ever chosen to <kanji>board</kanji>.
搭.on: She lands on the deck with a bump and stubs her <sound>toe</sound>.

昆.meaning: Great-grandma eats breakfast in the <part>sun</part> on her porch with <part>two spoons</part>: one for her and one for whoever is youngest. Over the years the second spoon passes from her son to her grandson to his tiny twins. That spoon has fed all her <kanji>descendants</kanji>.
昆.on: A <sound>con</sound>dor watches from the roof, hoping someone drops a spoonful.

醜.meaning: A vain <part>ghost</part> tries to scare a party with a stick of <part>dynamite</part>. It fizzles and goes off with a puff, and he's left with a sooty sheet, singed eyebrows and hair sticking up. The guests don't scream; they hand him a mirror. Even he finds himself <kanji>ugly</kanji>.
醜.on: He tries to wipe off the soot with an old <sound>shoe</sound>.
醜.kun: A <sound>mee</sound>rkat laughs so hard it bangs its <sound>knee</sound>, and the <sound>coo</sound>k brings it ice.
